declared_scope: Arbitrary unary numerical output for every deterministic tape table on ground pure-S trees. Certified at bare macro boundaries and after individual contractions. Direct project dependencies and transitive foundation axioms come from the compiled environment.

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.boardAction
proved.statement: (UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term) → (UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term) → (UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term) → UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.closed_single
proved.statement:
∀ (f : UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term) (r : UniformS.Region),
  UniformS.Readback.SlotOK r →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term),
      (∃ b, f = UniformS.BareMacro.fireY b) ∨ f = UniformS.BareMacro.skip →
        UniformS.BareMacro.listAction f (r.term ⋆ t) = Option.map (fun v => r.term ⋆ v) (UniformS.BareMacro.listAction f t)

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.done_closed
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (r : UniformS.Region),
  UniformS.Readback.FrameOK p r →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term) (f fin : UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term),
      (∃ b, f = UniformS.BareMacro.fireY b) ∨ f = UniformS.BareMacro.skip →
        UniformS.BareMacro.railAction f fin (r.term ⋆ t) = Option.map (fun v => r.term ⋆ v) (UniformS.BareMacro.railAction f fin t)

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.done_pop
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (r : UniformS.Region),
  UniformS.Readback.FrameOK p r →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term),
      UniformS.BareMacro.railAction UniformS.BareMacro.popY UniformS.BareMacro.skip (r.term ⋆ t) =
        UniformS.BareMacro.liftPop r.pop (fun v => v.term ⋆ t) (Option.map (fun v => r.term ⋆ v) (UniformS.BareMacro.railAction UniformS.BareMacro.popY UniformS.BareMacro.skip t))

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.fresh_fire
proved.statement:
∀ (b : Bool) (v : UniformS.Word) (vs : List UniformS.Word),
  UniformS.BareMacro.listAction (UniformS.BareMacro.fireY b) (UniformS.slots (v :: vs)) = some (UniformS.pair (UniformS.released b v).term (UniformS.slots vs))

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.fresh_pop
proved.statement: ∀ (vs : List UniformS.Word), UniformS.BareMacro.listAction UniformS.BareMacro.popY (UniformS.slots vs) = none

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.front_red
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (r j : Nat) (f : UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term),
  UniformS.BareMacro.railAction f UniformS.contract (UniformS.X (UniformS.template p) r ⋆ UniformS.X (UniformS.template p) j) =
    UniformS.contract (UniformS.X (UniformS.template p) r ⋆ UniformS.X (UniformS.template p) j)

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.front_skip
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (r j : Nat) (f : UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term),
  UniformS.BareMacro.railAction f UniformS.BareMacro.skip (UniformS.X (UniformS.template p) r ⋆ UniformS.X (UniformS.template p) j) = none

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.liftPop
proved.statement: {α : Type u_1} → Option (Bool × α) → (α → UniformS.Term) → Option UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.outer_closed_spec
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Sleeve),
  UniformS.Readback.OuterOK p s →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term) (f fin : UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term),
      (∃ b, f = UniformS.BareMacro.fireY b) ∨ f = UniformS.BareMacro.skip →
        UniformS.BareMacro.boardAction UniformS.BareMacro.skip f fin (UniformS.plug s t) = Option.map (UniformS.plug s) (UniformS.BareMacro.railAction f fin t)

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.outer_pop_spec
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Sleeve),
  UniformS.Readback.OuterOK p s →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term),
      UniformS.BareMacro.pop (UniformS.plug s t) =
        UniformS.BareMacro.liftPop (UniformS.popSleeve s) (fun ss => UniformS.plug ss t)
          (Option.map (UniformS.plug s) (UniformS.BareMacro.railAction UniformS.BareMacro.popY UniformS.BareMacro.skip t))

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.outer_rail_closed
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Sleeve),
  (∀ (r : UniformS.Region), r ∈ s → UniformS.Readback.FrameOK p r) →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term) (f fin : UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term),
      (∃ b, f = UniformS.BareMacro.fireY b) ∨ f = UniformS.BareMacro.skip →
        UniformS.BareMacro.railAction f fin (UniformS.plug s t) = Option.map (UniformS.plug s) (UniformS.BareMacro.railAction f fin t)

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.outer_rail_pop
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Sleeve),
  (∀ (r : UniformS.Region), r ∈ s → UniformS.Readback.FrameOK p r) →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term),
      UniformS.BareMacro.railAction UniformS.BareMacro.popY UniformS.BareMacro.skip (UniformS.plug s t) =
        UniformS.BareMacro.liftPop (UniformS.popSleeve s) (fun ss => UniformS.plug ss t)
          (Option.map (UniformS.plug s) (UniformS.BareMacro.railAction UniformS.BareMacro.popY UniformS.BareMacro.skip t))

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.pack_moves
proved.statement:
∀ (a : UniformS.Sleeve),
  (UniformS.pack a (UniformS.Region.raw UniformS.S)).pop =
    Option.map
      (fun x =>
        match x with
        | (b, zs) => (b, UniformS.pack zs (UniformS.Region.raw UniformS.S)))
      (UniformS.popSleeve a)

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.pop_segment
proved.statement:
∀ (w : UniformS.Segment),
  UniformS.BareMacro.popW w.term =
    match w.todo with
    | [] => none
    | b :: v => some (UniformS.Segment.read w.used b v).term

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.pop_spec
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board),
  UniformS.Readback.Valid p s → UniformS.BareMacro.pop (UniformS.Board.tree p s) = Option.map (fun x => UniformS.Board.tree p x.snd) s.pop

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.railAction
proved.statement: (UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term) → (UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term) → UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.row_closed
proved.statement:
∀ (f : UniformS.Term → Option UniformS.Term) (rs : UniformS.Sleeve),
  UniformS.Readback.SlotsOK rs →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term),
      (∃ b, f = UniformS.BareMacro.fireY b) ∨ f = UniformS.BareMacro.skip →
        UniformS.BareMacro.listAction f (UniformS.plug rs t) = Option.map (UniformS.plug rs) (UniformS.BareMacro.listAction f t)

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.row_pop
proved.statement:
∀ (rs : UniformS.Sleeve),
  UniformS.Readback.SlotsOK rs →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term),
      UniformS.BareMacro.listAction UniformS.BareMacro.popY (UniformS.plug rs t) =
        UniformS.BareMacro.liftPop (UniformS.popSleeve rs) (fun v => UniformS.plug v t) (Option.map (UniformS.plug rs) (UniformS.BareMacro.listAction UniformS.BareMacro.popY t))

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.row_single
proved.statement:
∀ (r : UniformS.Region),
  UniformS.Readback.SlotOK r →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term),
      UniformS.BareMacro.listAction UniformS.BareMacro.popY (r.term ⋆ t) =
        UniformS.BareMacro.liftPop r.pop (fun v => v.term ⋆ t) (Option.map (fun v => r.term ⋆ v) (UniformS.BareMacro.listAction UniformS.BareMacro.popY t))

proved.name: UniformS.Board.pop_sound
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) {s s' : UniformS.Board} {b : Bool},
  s.pop = some (b, s') → s.queue = b :: s'.queue ∧ s'.pending = s.pending ∧ UniformS.Native (UniformS.Board.tree p s) (UniformS.Board.tree p s')

proved.name: UniformS.fire_slot
proved.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (w : UniformS.Word), UniformS.Native (UniformS.slot w) (UniformS.released b w).term

proved.name: UniformS.pack_live
proved.statement: ∀ (l : UniformS.Sleeve) (t : UniformS.Region), (UniformS.pack l t).live = UniformS.visible l ++ t.live

proved.name: UniformS.pack_term
proved.statement: ∀ (l : UniformS.Sleeve) (t : UniformS.Region), (UniformS.pack l t).term = UniformS.plug l t.term

proved.name: UniformS.plug_append
proved.statement: ∀ (l k : UniformS.Sleeve) (t : UniformS.Term), UniformS.plug (l ++ k) t = UniformS.plug l (UniformS.plug k t)

proved.name: UniformS.plug_native
proved.statement: ∀ (l : UniformS.Sleeve) {a b : UniformS.Term}, UniformS.Native a b → UniformS.Native (UniformS.plug l a) (UniformS.plug l b)

proved.name: UniformS.plug_steps
proved.statement: ∀ (l : UniformS.Sleeve) {a b : UniformS.Term} {n : Nat}, UniformS.Steps n a b → UniformS.Steps n (UniformS.plug l a) (UniformS.plug l b)

proved.name: UniformS.popSleeve_none
proved.statement: ∀ (l : UniformS.Sleeve), UniformS.popSleeve l = none ↔ UniformS.visible l = []

proved.name: UniformS.popSleeve_sound
proved.statement:
∀ {l : UniformS.Sleeve} {b : Bool} {l' : UniformS.Sleeve},
  UniformS.popSleeve l = some (b, l') → UniformS.visible l = b :: UniformS.visible l' ∧ ∀ (t : UniformS.Term), UniformS.Native (UniformS.plug l t) (UniformS.plug l' t)

proved.name: UniformS.released_live
proved.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (v : UniformS.Word), (UniformS.released b v).live = UniformS.payload b v

proved.name: UniformS.seed_tree
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (w : UniformS.Word),
  UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.seed w) = UniformS.pair (UniformS.box (UniformS.emit w)) (UniformS.X (UniformS.template p) 0 ⋆ UniformS.X (UniformS.template p) 0)

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.action_valid
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board),
  UniformS.Readback.Valid p s →
    UniformS.Certified.action (UniformS.Board.tree p s) =
      Option.map
        (fun x =>
          match x with
          | (k, t) => (k, UniformS.Board.tree p t))
        (UniformS.advance p s)

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.all_program_queues
proved.statement:
∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (w : UniformS.Word) (n : Nat),
  UniformS.Readback.live (UniformS.Certified.orbit n (UniformS.Board.tree (UniformS.Bridge.compile p) (UniformS.seed w))) =
    (PureSFormal.CTS.iterate p n (PureSFormal.CTS.initial p w)).data

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.all_terms_native
proved.statement: ∀ (t u : UniformS.Term) (k : Nat), UniformS.Certified.action t = some (k, u) → 2 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ 4 ∧ UniformS.Steps k t u

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.code_inj
proved.statement: ∀ (s t : UniformS.Certified.State), UniformS.Certified.code s = UniformS.Certified.code t → s = t

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.folded_frame
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (r : UniformS.Region),
  UniformS.Readback.FrameOK p r → ∀ (t : UniformS.Term), (UniformS.Certified.fold (r.term ⋆ t)).rail = UniformS.Certified.first (List.head? r.live) (UniformS.Certified.fold t).rail

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.folded_frames
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (rs : UniformS.Sleeve),
  (∀ (r : UniformS.Region), r ∈ rs → UniformS.Readback.FrameOK p r) →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term), (UniformS.Certified.fold (UniformS.plug rs t)).rail = UniformS.Certified.first (List.head? (UniformS.visible rs)) (UniformS.Certified.fold t).rail

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.folded_front
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (r j : Nat), (UniformS.Certified.fold (UniformS.X (UniformS.template p) r ⋆ UniformS.X (UniformS.template p) j)).rail = none

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.folded_outer
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) {u : UniformS.Sleeve},
  UniformS.Readback.OuterOK p u →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term), (UniformS.Certified.fold (UniformS.plug u t)).root = UniformS.Certified.first (List.head? (UniformS.visible u)) (UniformS.Certified.fold t).rail

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.folded_row
proved.statement:
∀ (a : UniformS.Sleeve),
  UniformS.Readback.SlotsOK a →
    ∀ (t : UniformS.Term), (UniformS.Certified.fold (UniformS.plug a t)).row = UniformS.Certified.first (List.head? (UniformS.visible a)) (UniformS.Certified.fold t).row

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.folded_slot
proved.statement:
∀ (r : UniformS.Region),
  UniformS.Readback.SlotOK r → ∀ (t : UniformS.Term), (UniformS.Certified.fold (r.term ⋆ t)).row = UniformS.Certified.first (List.head? r.live) (UniformS.Certified.fold t).row

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.head_append
proved.statement: ∀ (x y : UniformS.Word), List.head? (x ++ y) = UniformS.Certified.first (List.head? x) (List.head? y)

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.head_correct
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board), UniformS.Readback.Valid p s → (UniformS.Certified.fold (UniformS.Board.tree p s)).root = List.head? s.queue

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.orbit_literal
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (w : UniformS.Word) (n : Nat),
  UniformS.Certified.orbit n (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.seed w)) = UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.Bridge.sample p n (UniformS.seed w))

proved.name: UniformS.Certified.universal_selected_halting
proved.statement:
∀ (m : PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Instance),
  PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Halts m ↔
    ∃ n, UniformS.Certified.halt (UniformS.Certified.orbit n (UniformS.Board.tree UniformS.Bridge.fixed (UniformS.Bridge.input m))) = true

proved.name: UniformS.copy_exact
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Address) (t : UniformS.Term), UniformS.copyStep p t = UniformS.reduceAt p t

proved.name: UniformS.descend
proved.statement: UniformS.Address → UniformS.Term → List UniformS.Crumb → Option (UniformS.Term × List UniformS.Crumb)

proved.name: UniformS.root_leaf_count
proved.statement: ∀ (x y z : UniformS.Term), UniformS.leaves (x ⋆ z ⋆ (y ⋆ z)) + 1 = UniformS.leaves (UniformS.S ⋆ x ⋆ y ⋆ z) + UniformS.leaves z

proved.name: UniformS.spine_agrees
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Address) (t : UniformS.Term) (c : List UniformS.Crumb),
  ((UniformS.descend p t c).bind fun x =>
      match x with
      | (v, cs) => Option.map (UniformS.rebuild cs) (UniformS.contract v)) =
    Option.map (UniformS.rebuild c) (UniformS.reduceAt p t)

proved.name: UniformS.step_cost
proved.statement: ∀ {a b : UniformS.Term}, UniformS.Native a b → UniformS.leaves a ≤ UniformS.leaves b ∧ UniformS.leaves b ≤ 2 * UniformS.leaves a ∧ UniformS.height b ≤ UniformS.height a + 1

proved.name: UniformS.trajectory_cost
proved.statement: ∀ {n : Nat} {a b : UniformS.Term}, UniformS.Steps n a b → UniformS.leaves b ≤ 2 ^ n * UniformS.leaves a ∧ UniformS.height b ≤ UniformS.height a + n

proved.name: UniformS.added_marks
proved.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (v : UniformS.Word), (UniformS.added b v).marks = UniformS.marked false (UniformS.payload b v)

proved.name: UniformS.board_transfer
proved.statement: ∀ {s s' : UniformS.Board} {b : Bool}, s.pop = some (b, s') → s'.marks = UniformS.markFirst s.marks

proved.name: UniformS.fire_marks
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (a : UniformS.Port) (b : Bool), (UniformS.Port.fire p a b).marks = a.board.marks ++ UniformS.marked false (UniformS.payload b a.current)

proved.name: UniformS.full_history
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) {n : Nat} {a c : UniformS.Config},
  UniformS.Run p n a c →
    ∀ (s : UniformS.Board) (hist : UniformS.Word),
      UniformS.observe s = a →
        s.marks = UniformS.marked true hist ++ UniformS.marked false s.queue →
          ∃ k t h',
            2 * n ≤ k ∧
              k ≤ 4 * n ∧
                UniformS.Steps k (UniformS.Board.tree p s) (UniformS.Board.tree p t) ∧
                  UniformS.observe t = c ∧ List.length h' = n ∧ t.marks = UniformS.marked true (hist ++ h') ++ UniformS.marked false t.queue

proved.name: UniformS.ground_history
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (w : UniformS.Word) {n : Nat} {c : UniformS.Config},
  UniformS.Run p n { queue := w, remaining := [] } c →
    ∃ k t hist,
      2 * n ≤ k ∧
        k ≤ 4 * n ∧
          UniformS.Steps k (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.seed w)) (UniformS.Board.tree p t) ∧
            UniformS.observe t = c ∧ List.length hist = n ∧ t.marks = UniformS.marked true hist ++ UniformS.marked false t.queue

proved.name: UniformS.mark_append
proved.statement: ∀ (a b : List UniformS.Mark), UniformS.markFirst (a ++ b) = if List.isEmpty (UniformS.remainingMarks a) = true then a ++ UniformS.markFirst b else UniformS.markFirst a ++ b

proved.name: UniformS.marked_remaining
proved.statement: ∀ (u : Bool) (w : UniformS.Word), UniformS.remainingMarks (UniformS.marked u w) = if u = true then [] else w

proved.name: UniformS.pack_marks
proved.statement: ∀ (a : UniformS.Sleeve) (r : UniformS.Region), (UniformS.pack a r).marks = UniformS.sleeveMarks a ++ r.marks

proved.name: UniformS.physical_history_step
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) {s t : UniformS.Board} {n : Nat},
  UniformS.advance p s = some (n, t) →
    ∀ (hist tail : UniformS.Word) (b : Bool),
      s.marks = UniformS.marked true hist ++ UniformS.marked false (b :: tail) →
        ∃ v, UniformS.phaseList p s = v :: t.pending ∧ t.marks = UniformS.marked true (hist ++ [b]) ++ UniformS.marked false (tail ++ UniformS.payload b v)

proved.name: UniformS.region_transfer
proved.statement: ∀ {r r' : UniformS.Region} {b : Bool}, r.pop = some (b, r') → r'.marks = UniformS.markFirst r.marks

proved.name: UniformS.remaining_join
proved.statement: ∀ (a b : List UniformS.Mark), UniformS.remainingMarks (a ++ b) = UniformS.remainingMarks a ++ UniformS.remainingMarks b

proved.name: UniformS.sleeve_transfer
proved.statement: ∀ {s s' : UniformS.Sleeve} {b : Bool}, UniformS.popSleeve s = some (b, s') → UniformS.sleeveMarks s' = UniformS.markFirst (UniformS.sleeveMarks s)

proved.name: UniformS.exact_encoder_leaves
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (w : UniformS.Word),
  UniformS.leaves (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.seed w)) = 22 + 48 * p.period.length + 4 * UniformS.periodWeight p.period + UniformS.wordWeight w

proved.name: UniformS.list_size
proved.statement: ∀ (ws : List UniformS.Word), UniformS.leaves (UniformS.slots ws) = 1 + 12 * ws.length + UniformS.periodWeight ws

proved.name: UniformS.word_weight_bounds
proved.statement: ∀ (w : UniformS.Word), 3 * List.length w ≤ UniformS.wordWeight w ∧ UniformS.wordWeight w ≤ 4 * List.length w

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.board_shift
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (n : Nat) (s : UniformS.Board), UniformS.Bridge.sample p (n + 1) s = UniformS.Bridge.sample p n (UniformS.Bridge.tick p s)

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.complete_prefix
proved.statement: ∀ {p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program} {c : PureSFormal.CTS.Config p} {hist : UniformS.Word}, UniformS.Archive.Complete p c hist → ∃ extra, hist = c.data ++ extra

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.completed_ground
UniformS.Archive.empty_after
proved.statement:
∀ {p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program} {c : PureSFormal.CTS.Config p} {hist : UniformS.Word},
  UniformS.Archive.Complete p c hist → ∀ (j : Nat), List.length hist ≤ j → (PureSFormal.CTS.iterate p j c).data = []

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.empty_at_end
proved.statement:
∀ {p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program} {c : PureSFormal.CTS.Config p} {hist : UniformS.Word},
  UniformS.Archive.Complete p c hist → (PureSFormal.CTS.iterate p (List.length hist) c).data = []

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.from_empty
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (n : Nat) (s : UniformS.Board), s.queue = [] → UniformS.Archive.fromBoard p n s = s

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.from_sample
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (n : Nat) (s : UniformS.Board), UniformS.Archive.fromBoard p n s = UniformS.Bridge.sample p n s

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.iterate_shift
proved.statement: ∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (i : Nat) (c : PureSFormal.CTS.Config p), PureSFormal.CTS.iterate p (i + 1) c = PureSFormal.CTS.iterate p i (PureSFormal.CTS.absorbingStep p c)

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.native_consumption
proved.statement:
∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (n : Nat) (s : UniformS.Board) (c : PureSFormal.CTS.Config p),
  UniformS.Bridge.Matches s c →
    ∀ (before : UniformS.Word),
      s.marks = UniformS.marked true before ++ UniformS.marked false s.queue →
        (UniformS.Archive.fromBoard (UniformS.Bridge.compile p) n s).queue = [] →
          ∃ hist, UniformS.Archive.Complete p c hist ∧ (UniformS.Archive.fromBoard (UniformS.Bridge.compile p) n s).marks = UniformS.marked true (before ++ hist)

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.observations
proved.statement: (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) → Nat → PureSFormal.CTS.Config p → Nat → List (Nat × PureSFormal.CTS.Config p)

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.observations_mem
proved.statement:
∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (n : Nat) (c : PureSFormal.CTS.Config p) (k : Nat) (a : Nat × PureSFormal.CTS.Config p),
  a ∈ UniformS.Archive.observations p n c k ↔ ∃ j, j ≤ k ∧ a = (n + j, PureSFormal.CTS.iterate p j c)

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.windows
proved.statement: (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) → Nat → PureSFormal.CTS.Phase p → Nat → UniformS.Word → List (Nat × PureSFormal.CTS.Config p)

proved.name: UniformS.Archive.windows_exact
proved.statement:
∀ {p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program} {c : PureSFormal.CTS.Config p} {hist : UniformS.Word},
  UniformS.Archive.Complete p c hist → ∀ (n : Nat), UniformS.Archive.windows p n c.phase c.data.length hist = UniformS.Archive.observations p n c (List.length hist)

proved.name: UniformS.Output.any_bit_channel
proved.statement:
∀ (ms : List PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Instance) (i : Nat)
  (m : PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Instance),
  ms[i]? = some m →
    (PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Halts m ↔ ∃ n, UniformS.Output.seen (UniformS.Output.iter n (UniformS.Output.encode ms)) i = true)

proved.name: UniformS.Output.binary_io
proved.statement:
∀ (a b : PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Instance),
  ¬(PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Halts a ∧ PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Halts b) →
    ∀ (y : Bool),

proved.statement: ∀ (c : UniformS.Ctx) {n : Nat} {x y : UniformS.Term}, UniformS.Steps n x y → UniformS.Steps n (c.fill x) (c.fill y)

proved.name: UniformS.Region.pop_sound
proved.statement: ∀ {a : UniformS.Region} {b : Bool} {a' : UniformS.Region}, a.pop = some (b, a') → a.live = b :: a'.live ∧ UniformS.Native a.term a'.term

proved.name: UniformS.markFirst_prefix
proved.statement: ∀ (w : UniformS.Word) (t : List UniformS.Mark), UniformS.markFirst (UniformS.marked true w ++ t) = UniformS.marked true w ++ UniformS.markFirst t

proved.name: UniformS.segment_read
proved.statement: ∀ (used : List (Bool × UniformS.Term)) (b : Bool) (tail : List Bool), UniformS.Native { used := used, todo := b :: tail }.term (UniformS.Segment.read used b tail).term

proved.name: UniformS.shell_snoc
proved.statement: ∀ (xs : List (Bool × UniformS.Term)) (b : Bool) (g v : UniformS.Term), (UniformS.shell (xs ++ [(b, g)])).fill v = (UniformS.shell xs).fill (UniformS.spent b v g)

proved.name: UniformS.untouched_term
proved.statement: ∀ (c : UniformS.Ctx) (t : UniformS.Region), (UniformS.untouched c t).term = c.fill t.term

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.all_bare_samples
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (w : UniformS.Word) (n : Nat),
  UniformS.BareMacro.run n (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.seed w)) = UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.Bridge.sample p n (UniformS.seed w))

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.alloc_succ
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (u : UniformS.Sleeve) (r j : Nat),
  UniformS.Readback.OuterOK p u →
    UniformS.BareMacro.alloc (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.Board.frontier u (r + 1) j)) =
      some (UniformS.Board.tree p { outer := u, inner := [], current := p.first, rest := p.rest, stamp := j, leftIndex := r, rightIndex := j }.board)

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.alloc_zero
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (u : UniformS.Sleeve) (j : Nat),
  UniformS.Readback.OuterOK p u →
    UniformS.BareMacro.alloc (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.Board.frontier u 0 j)) = some (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.Board.frontier u (j + 1) (j + 1)))

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.finish_spec
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board) (b : Bool),
  UniformS.Readback.Valid p s →
    UniformS.BareMacro.finish b (UniformS.Board.tree p s) = some ((UniformS.prepare p s).fst + 1, UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.Port.fire p (UniformS.prepare p s).snd b))

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.fire_front
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (u : UniformS.Sleeve) (r j : Nat),
  UniformS.Readback.OuterOK p u → ∀ (b : Bool), UniformS.BareMacro.fire b (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.Board.frontier u r j)) = none

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.fire_port
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Port) (b : Bool),
  UniformS.Readback.Valid p s.board → UniformS.BareMacro.fire b (UniformS.Board.tree p s.board) = some (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.Port.fire p s b))

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.live_valid
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board), UniformS.Readback.Valid p s → UniformS.Readback.live (UniformS.Board.tree p s) = s.queue

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.registered_source
proved.statement:
∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (w : UniformS.Word) (n : Nat),
  UniformS.Readback.live (UniformS.BareMacro.run n (UniformS.Board.tree (UniformS.Bridge.compile p) (UniformS.seed w))) =
    (PureSFormal.CTS.iterate p n (PureSFormal.CTS.initial p w)).data

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.selected_spec
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board),
  UniformS.Readback.Valid p s →
    UniformS.BareMacro.selected (UniformS.Board.tree p s) =
      Option.map
        (fun x =>
          match x with
          | (k, t) => (k, UniformS.Board.tree p t))
        (UniformS.advance p s)

proved.name: UniformS.BareMacro.tape_halts_iff_selected
proved.statement:
∀ (m : PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Instance),
  PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Halts m ↔
    ∃ n, UniformS.Readback.live (UniformS.BareMacro.run n (UniformS.Board.tree UniformS.Bridge.fixed (UniformS.Bridge.input m))) = []

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.First
proved.statement: {Q : Type} → {r : Nat} → UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem Q r → UniformS.Separation.Vec UniformS.Term r → Nat → Prop

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem.abstractTick
proved.statement: {Q : Type} → {r : Nat} → UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem Q r → UniformS.Separation.Vec Q r → UniformS.Separation.Vec Q r

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem.obs
proved.statement: {Q : Type} → {r : Nat} → UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem Q r → UniformS.Separation.Vec UniformS.Term r → UniformS.Separation.Vec Q r

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem.orbit
proved.statement:
∀ {Q : Type} {r : Nat} (m : UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem Q r) (n : Nat) (v : UniformS.Separation.Vec UniformS.Term r),
  m.obs (UniformS.Separation.walk m.tick n v) = UniformS.Separation.walk m.abstractTick n (m.obs v)

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem.tick
proved.statement: {Q : Type} → {r : Nat} → UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem Q r → UniformS.Separation.Vec UniformS.Term r → UniformS.Separation.Vec UniformS.Term r

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.combined_cutoff
proved.statement:
∀ {Q : Type} {r : Nat} (all : List Q),
  (∀ (q : Q), q ∈ all) →
    ∀ (m : UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem Q r) (v : UniformS.Separation.Vec UniformS.Term r),
      (∃ n, m.accept (m.obs (UniformS.Separation.walk m.tick n v)) = true) ↔
        ((List.range (all.length ^ r)).any fun k => m.accept (UniformS.Separation.walk m.abstractTick k (m.obs v))) = true

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.evalE
proved.statement: {α : Type} → {r : Nat} → α → (α → α → α) → UniformS.Separation.Vec α r → UniformS.Separation.Expr r → α

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.eval_folds
proved.statement:
∀ {Q : Type} {r : Nat} (s : Q) (op : Q → Q → Q) (v : UniformS.Separation.Vec UniformS.Term r) (e : UniformS.Separation.Expr r),
  UniformS.Separation.foldT s op (UniformS.Separation.evalE UniformS.S UniformS.Term.app v e) =
    UniformS.Separation.evalE s op (UniformS.Separation.mapV (UniformS.Separation.foldT s op) r v) e

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.finite_cutoff
proved.statement:
∀ {Q : Type} (all : List Q),
  (∀ (q : Q), q ∈ all) →
    ∀ (f : Q → Q) (accept : Q → Bool) (q : Q),
      (∃ n, accept (UniformS.Separation.walk f n q) = true) ↔ ((List.range all.length).any fun n => accept (UniformS.Separation.walk f n q)) = true

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.first_numeric_cutoff
proved.statement:
∀ {Q : Type} {r : Nat} (all : List Q),
  (∀ (q : Q), q ∈ all) →
    ∀ (m : UniformS.Separation.RegisterSystem Q r) (v : UniformS.Separation.Vec UniformS.Term r) (read : UniformS.Separation.Vec UniformS.Term r → Option Nat) (y : Nat),
      (∃ n, UniformS.Separation.First m v n ∧ read (UniformS.Separation.walk m.tick n v) = some y) ↔
        ∃ n, n < all.length ^ r ∧ UniformS.Separation.First m v n ∧ read (UniformS.Separation.walk m.tick n v) = some y

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.foldT
proved.statement: {Q : Sort u_1} → Q → (Q → Q → Q) → UniformS.Term → Q

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.getV
proved.statement: {α : Type} → (n : Nat) → UniformS.Separation.Vec α n → Fin n → α

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.get_map
proved.statement:
∀ {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (n : Nat) (v : UniformS.Separation.Vec α n) (i : Fin n),
  UniformS.Separation.getV n (UniformS.Separation.mapV f n v) i = f (UniformS.Separation.getV n v i)

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.mapV
proved.statement: {α β : Type} → (α → β) → (n : Nat) → UniformS.Separation.Vec α n → UniformS.Separation.Vec β n

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.parallel_folds
proved.statement:
∀ {Q : Type} {r : Nat} (s : Q) (op : Q → Q → Q) (v : UniformS.Separation.Vec UniformS.Term r) (k : Nat) (es : UniformS.Separation.Vec (UniformS.Separation.Expr r) k),
  UniformS.Separation.mapV (UniformS.Separation.foldT s op) k (UniformS.Separation.mapV (UniformS.Separation.evalE UniformS.S UniformS.Term.app v) k es) =
    UniformS.Separation.mapV (UniformS.Separation.evalE s op (UniformS.Separation.mapV (UniformS.Separation.foldT s op) r v)) k es

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.vectors
proved.statement: {α : Type} → List α → (n : Nat) → List (UniformS.Separation.Vec α n)

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.vectors_complete
proved.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (all : List α), (∀ (a : α), a ∈ all) → ∀ (n : Nat) (v : UniformS.Separation.Vec α n), v ∈ UniformS.Separation.vectors all n

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.vectors_length
proved.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (all : List α) (n : Nat), (UniformS.Separation.vectors all n).length = all.length ^ n

proved.name: UniformS.Separation.walk_add
proved.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (f : α → α) (i j : Nat) (a : α), UniformS.Separation.walk f (i + j) a = UniformS.Separation.walk f j (UniformS.Separation.walk f i a)

proved.name: UniformS.fire_spec
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Port) (b : Bool),
  (UniformS.Port.fire p s b).queue = s.board.queue ++ UniformS.payload b s.current ∧
    (UniformS.Port.fire p s b).pending = s.rest ∧ UniformS.Native (UniformS.Board.tree p s.board) (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.Port.fire p s b))

proved.name: UniformS.ground_trace
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (w : UniformS.Word) {n : Nat} {c : UniformS.Config},
  UniformS.Run p n { queue := w, remaining := [] } c →
    ∃ k t, 2 * n ≤ k ∧ k ≤ 4 * n ∧ UniformS.Steps k (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.seed w)) (UniformS.Board.tree p t) ∧ UniformS.observe t = c

proved.name: UniformS.lift_step
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board) {c : UniformS.Config},
  UniformS.source p (UniformS.observe s) = some c → ∃ n t, UniformS.advance p s = some (n, t) ∧ UniformS.observe t = c

proved.name: UniformS.macro_exact
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) {s t : UniformS.Board} {n : Nat},
  UniformS.advance p s = some (n, t) →
    2 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 4 ∧ UniformS.Steps n (UniformS.Board.tree p s) (UniformS.Board.tree p t) ∧ UniformS.source p (UniformS.observe s) = some (UniformS.observe t)

proved.name: UniformS.macro_none
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board), UniformS.advance p s = none ↔ s.queue = []

proved.name: UniformS.prepare_spec
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board),
  match UniformS.prepare p s with
  | (n, k) => n ≤ 2 ∧ UniformS.Steps n (UniformS.Board.tree p s) (UniformS.Board.tree p k.board) ∧ k.board.queue = s.queue ∧ k.current :: k.rest = UniformS.phaseList p s

proved.name: UniformS.run_refines
proved.statement:
∀ (p : UniformS.Program) {n : Nat} {a b : UniformS.Config},
  UniformS.Run p n a b →
    ∀ (s : UniformS.Board), UniformS.observe s = a → ∃ k t, 2 * n ≤ k ∧ k ≤ 4 * n ∧ UniformS.Steps k (UniformS.Board.tree p s) (UniformS.Board.tree p t) ∧ UniformS.observe t = b

proved.name: UniformS.Bridge.cursor_active
proved.statement:
∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (i : PureSFormal.CTS.Phase p),
  (if (UniformS.Bridge.cursor p i).isEmpty = true then (UniformS.Bridge.compile p).period else UniformS.Bridge.cursor p i) = List.drop (↑i) (UniformS.Bridge.table p)

proved.name: UniformS.Bridge.cursor_next
proved.statement: ∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (i : PureSFormal.CTS.Phase p), UniformS.Bridge.cursor p (PureSFormal.CTS.nextPhase p i) = List.drop (↑i + 1) (UniformS.Bridge.table p)

proved.name: UniformS.Bridge.sample_agrees
proved.statement:
∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (w : UniformS.Word) (n : Nat),
  UniformS.Bridge.Matches (UniformS.Bridge.sample (UniformS.Bridge.compile p) n (UniformS.seed w)) (PureSFormal.CTS.iterate p n (PureSFormal.CTS.initial p w))

proved.name: UniformS.Bridge.sample_native
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board) (n : Nat), ∃ k, k ≤ 4 * n ∧ UniformS.Steps k (UniformS.Board.tree p s) (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.Bridge.sample p n s))

proved.name: UniformS.Bridge.source_agrees
proved.statement:
∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (i : PureSFormal.CTS.Phase p) (b : Bool) (v : UniformS.Word),
  UniformS.source (UniformS.Bridge.compile p) (UniformS.Bridge.snapshot p { phase := i, data := b :: v }) =
    some (UniformS.Bridge.snapshot p (PureSFormal.CTS.absorbingStep p { phase := i, data := b :: v }))

proved.name: UniformS.Bridge.table_split
proved.statement: ∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (i : PureSFormal.CTS.Phase p), List.drop (↑i) (UniformS.Bridge.table p) = p.appendant i :: List.drop (↑i + 1) (UniformS.Bridge.table p)

proved.name: UniformS.Bridge.tape_halts_iff_native_samples
proved.statement:
∀ (m : PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Instance),
  PureSFormal.Research.ProtectedTrieDeterministicCompiler.DeterministicTape.Halts m ↔
    ∃ n k,
      k ≤ 4 * n ∧
        UniformS.Steps k (UniformS.Board.tree UniformS.Bridge.fixed (UniformS.Bridge.input m))
            (UniformS.Board.tree UniformS.Bridge.fixed (UniformS.Bridge.sample UniformS.Bridge.fixed n (UniformS.Bridge.input m))) ∧
          (UniformS.Bridge.sample UniformS.Bridge.fixed n (UniformS.Bridge.input m)).queue = []

proved.name: UniformS.Bridge.tick_agrees
proved.statement:
∀ (p : PureSFormal.CTS.Program) (s : UniformS.Board) (c : PureSFormal.CTS.Config p),
  UniformS.Bridge.Matches s c → UniformS.Bridge.Matches (UniformS.Bridge.tick (UniformS.Bridge.compile p) s) (PureSFormal.CTS.absorbingStep p c)

proved.name: UniformS.Automaton.parse_history
proved.statement: ∀ (h : List (Bool × UniformS.Term)) (w : UniformS.Word), (UniformS.Automaton.run { used := h, todo := w }.term).word = some (UniformS.Automaton.segmentInfo (List.map Prod.fst h) w)

proved.name: UniformS.Automaton.parse_live
proved.statement:
∀ (b : Bool) (w : UniformS.Term),
  (UniformS.Automaton.run (UniformS.readCell b w)).word = UniformS.Automaton.joinR (some (UniformS.Automaton.liveToken false)) (UniformS.Automaton.run w).word

proved.name: UniformS.Automaton.parse_spent

∀ (b : Bool) (w g : UniformS.Term),

proved.name: UniformS.Automaton.seed_detector
proved.statement: ∀ (p : UniformS.Program) (w : UniformS.Word), UniformS.Automaton.halt (UniformS.Board.tree p (UniformS.seed w)) = List.isEmpty w
